name: Tables declared as data
summary: Each repository declares its tables in a small readable file - fields, types, required, allowed values, patterns - and tad checks every row against it. The same declaration serves ocoeco's shared shapes, and others to come.
why: A schema in SQL needs a database to mean anything; a declaration as data is read by people and by any tool.

name: Three ways into the same data
summary: A tad dataset is files you can read and diff, text you can reshape with jq and Miller, and a database you can query with SQL and joins - one dataset, with every change brought back to the same canonical files.
why: Nothing else offered all three at once (Dolt hides history, gitsheets has no SQL, plain files have no queries); that is tad's reason to exist - and its whole concern: what is done with the data (pages, the observatory, anything else) belongs to the tools that use it.
